pairs.subject: quality-gates
pairs.evidence: src/features/projects/development/goals/progressShared.tsx:145 The goals surface counts every goal that isn't done as active, with no last-touched predicate. A goal nobody has touched in a year reads exactly like one worked yesterday, even though DevGoal carries updated_at to derive it from.

techniques.evidence: src/features/projects/development/goals/progressShared.tsx:145 The active count's predicate is 'admitted and not done'. A grep of the goals directory for stale/last-touched/updated_at found no staleness rendering, even though updated_at exists on the DevGoal binding.

src/features/projects/development/goals/goalStatus.ts:49 'skipped' is normalised to 'done', so a waived obligation is filed as satisfied. Unknown statuses fall back to 'open' (line 28, asserted in goalStatus.test.ts:39), so an unknown state is rendered as a definite value.
src/features/projects/development/goals/goalStatus.ts:28 An unrecognised status is silently mapped to a real state instead of an explicit unknown.

pairs.subject: quality-gates
pairs.evidence: src/features/vault/shared/utils/credentialHealthScore.ts:60 Missing anomaly data (and, at line 65, a missing rotation policy) scores 100, so absence reads as compliance. An unreachable or unverifiable probe therefore still produces a composite of 80 and tier 'healthy'; the threestate test asserts tier 'healthy' for unreachable. That defeats the neutral-50 fix the comment above it claims.

techniques.evidence: src/features/vault/shared/utils/credentialHealthScore.ts:60 Unmeasured sub-scores are folded in at full marks instead of being skipped or announced. Only the all-null case refuses, with tier 'unknown' (line 137).
src/features/vault/shared/utils/credentialHealthScore.ts:50 A known false alarm (unreachable scored 0, critical) was fixed by narrowing the mapping rather than dropping the signal.

declined.reason: The listed files are presentational (page, glyphs, navigation, chat frame variants) with no refusal or verdict machinery I could find. Not-applicable cannot be cleanly claimed because the companions directory contains gate vocabulary elsewhere (exitCode in useAthenaFleetBridge.ts, 'baseline'), so the driver's absence search would hit.

declined.reason: Layout primitives and buttons contain no gating machinery. A search of layout/kanban/buttons for process.exit, exitCode, max-warnings, lefthook, baseline and waiver found nothing, but no manifest or config line exists to anchor a not-applicable verdict, and a component's first line does not prove absence.
